svg.title: How repeated Pólya urn draws create paths and an endpoint distribution
svg.desc: A small example starts with two red and five blue balls and follows every possible urn state over three reinforced draws. Blue draws branch left and red draws branch right. Paths with the same red and blue counts merge. The four final red ratios, 0.20, 0.30, 0.40, and 0.50, form a histogram with probabilities about 42, 36, 18, and 5 percent.
svg.text: bar height ≈ share of simulated paths
Paths that reach the same urn counts merge; the app aggregates their segments and counts their final ratios.
